basics.name: Pau Rubiella Galindo
basics.label: Senior Backend Engineer
basics.summary: Backend engineer with 10+ years in PHP and Symfony, the last two in payments. I own features end to end across PHP, .NET, Kubernetes and AWS, lead incident recovery and build alerting that catches issues before customers do. Early adopter of AI tools and spec-driven development. I share what I learn and learn from my team.

work.name: Docplanner
work.summary: Payments team (full remote): led infrastructure work with .NET, AWS and Kubernetes. Built PHP features with DDD, CQRS and AI-assisted development.
highlights: Led **a new payment feature for two markets** with a new payment provider, from design to production.

AI-assisted engineering with **Claude Code** and **Cursor**: built 8 skills and tools used by the whole team (payment-provider sandbox, read-only production database access, message-template checkers) and improved 27 shared skills. Learned .NET with AI support.
Built an AI skill to manage test environments and adapted it to a new testing platform. Ran **AI training sessions** and a cross-team demo.
Built payment alerting as code with **Datadog**, **OpenTelemetry** and runbooks that caught a silent onboarding outage. Led an incident recovery that got back 82% of the affected value.
Delivered key parts of Spain's e-invoicing compliance (**VeriFactu**) under a legal deadline, and closed authorization gaps in fiscal invoicing.
Stabilized the invoicing service and cut its cost on my own initiative: Redis to **DragonflyDB**, horizontal scaling, unused databases removed.
Team multiplier: set up **cloud dev environments** for several backend and frontend apps, adopted company-wide. Mentored four engineers.

work.name: ATRÁPALO
work.summary: Urban Leisure team (hybrid), managing the catalog of activities and shows.
highlights: Integrated third-party providers via **REST APIs** to enrich and enhance the catalog, in Symfony **microservices** built with **DDD, CQRS** and hexagonal architecture.
Ran **internal training sessions** and coordinated with external teams.
Improved the CI pipelines and migrated the **Docker Swarm** stack to **Kubernetes**.
Maintained and fixed legacy code while gradually migrating it to new microservices for scalability.

work.name: JOYNERS

highlights: Managed **web servers and S3 backups** and ran the project in Bitbucket.

work.name: FREAKSHEEP
work.summary: Co-founded a studio developing multi-platform applications and services (remote and on-site).

Managed projects with Jira, Bitbucket and Slack, and built **web and mobile apps** using **Symfony** and **AngularJS** plus **Ionic**.
